$comment: Who does what when Claude Code and Codex make a video together. `prai review` reads this file. Explained in docs/roles.md.

does: writes the storyboard, prai.json, capture plans and code
decides on each review finding (accept / partial / reject + why)
builds anything new itself (synthetic data, assets, blocks)
never: hands a decision back to the person that it can make itself
claims a check it did not run
kills processes it did not start

does: reviews: facts and exaggeration, beat sheets, frame sheets, code, reference picks
may use web search for research (results stay 'candidate' until watched)
reviewer.on_model_failure: stop and report the cause (quota, billing, plan). Do not switch to another model silently; a round run on another model is redone.
reviewer.effort_note: per review kind; `final` is used automatically for the last allowed round. Design decisions and QA verdicts made outside `prai review` also use xhigh.

plan: render: frames (code too when the engine changed)
rounds.last_round: fix everything it found, side effects included, then stop. What remains goes to 'known limits' in reviews/ledger.md.
rounds.stop_early_when: findings are mostly side effects of the previous round's fixes

long_runs.rule: freeze the code, give Codex the checking code and a sample of logs in one xhigh review, run once, then fix only safety defects and re-run only the affected cases

does: sets the goal and the taste (references)
watches the final video once with sound
is_not_asked: 'should I do A or B?' for things the director can decide
